Robert Guest

Deputy editor



 I’ve reported from more than 100 countries, so when I say America is unique, I’m not basing that assessment on nothing. It is—by far—the place that the largest number of people want to move to. That has always been its greatest strength. If lots of fertile land and natural resources were what mattered most, Russia would be a paradise.
